data.name: Dilara
data.gender_notes: Dilara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dilara is a name that signifies being the beloved or the heart's desire. It is often given to girls born into families who value love and affection. The name Dilara carries the meaning “Beloved, Heart's Desire” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Urdu, Turkish. Parents who choose Dilara usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, heart's desire and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name reflects the Islamic value of being loved and cherished by Allah, as seen in the Quranic concept of being 'beloved' by God.
data.etymology: Dilara belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved, Heart's Desire.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilara total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ديلارا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الجمال و الرقة و الحسن
in_arabic.long_meaning: ديلارا اسم مشتق من الفارسية و يعني الجميلة و الرقيقة و الحسناء، و قد ورد في بعض الروايات أنه يدل على الفتاة الجميلة التي تبهج الناظرين بجمالها و حسنها، و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و راقية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: دلارا
in_urdu.long_meaning: دلارا ایک فارسی سے ماخوذ نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت، پیاری، محبوب۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورت اور پیاری لڑکی کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب دل کو بھانے والا اور محبوب بھی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दिलारा
in_hindi.long_meaning: दिलारा एक फारसी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर, प्रिय, प्यारी। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक सुंदर और आकर्षक लड़की के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम दिल को छू लेने वाला और प्रिय भी होता है।

in_pashto.name: ډیلارا
in_pashto.long_meaning: ډیلارا د فارسي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی چې معنی یې ښایسته، ګرانه، مینه ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو کړاوو کې د یوې ښکلې او مینه ناکې نجلۍ لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Dilara
in_english.long_meaning: Dilara is a name derived from Persian, meaning beautiful, beloved, or charming. It is used in various Muslim cultures to signify a beautiful and lovely girl. Etymologically, it relates to Arabic roots that imply beauty and affection. Historically, the name has been used in Islamic tradition to describe a girl who brings joy and beauty to those around her. The name Dilara is associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, charm, and loveliness.
